title: Cloud browser.controller.register rejects every production session with 4403 because it reads a session 'profile' key that no session builder stamps

candidates.author: musabatas
candidates.mergeable_github: UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN (GitHub has not computed it; re-queried 2026-10-01)
candidates.has_tests: yes: test_cloud_controller_registration_uses_created_session_profile (session.create default -> ops -> default, then register; launch profile patched to 'default'). It fails on main (4403) and passes with the fix.
candidates.approach: One line: profile_id = profile_name_for_home(session.get('profile_home')) or _current_profile_name(), using the module globals server.py already binds. Labels type/bug, comp/tui, tool/browser, P2, sweeper:risk-session-state, area/profiles. No linked issue.

regression_test.source: new; built from #119346's session.create round-trip test plus kvnloo fork #51's artifact-store slot test (test_browser_control_profile_repro_real.py::test_cloud_profile_id_hits_local_api_artifact_store_slot)
tests: test_created_session_registers_with_its_canonical_profile[launch-named] (launch 'work': none -> work, default (home = Hermes root) -> default, ops -> ops)
regression_test.contract: A session made by session.create registers a cloud browser controller without 4403, and the scope's profile_id is the session's canonical profile name: the launch profile's name when profile_home is None, 'default' when the home is the Hermes root, '<name>' for <root>/profiles/<name>. The attached scope selects the local-API artifact-store slot keyed by that name.

main.detail: 3 failed / 0 passed. Every create -> register returns {'error': {'code': 4403, 'message': 'controller_id, browser_profile_id, and server session profile are required'}}.

119346.detail: 3/3, merges clean (head d6c5a4a67e). Probe matrix: all 5 launch/request cases give the canonical name.

fork#51 (kvnloo, reference, not an upstr.detail: 2 failed / 1 passed (commit a2b896ff5c cherry-picks clean). Path(profile_home).name or literal 'default': a gateway launched under 'work' registers launch-profile sessions as 'default' (assert 'default' == 'work'), and a session whose profile_home is the Hermes root (a 'default' request on a named-launch gateway, per server._profile_home) registers as the root's basename ('hermes_test' in the sandbox, '.hermes' on a real install), so the artifact-store slot lookup misses.

negative_control.detail: On main + #119346: reverting its line to session.get('profile') re-fails 3/3 (4403); keeping profile_name_for_home but dropping the _current_profile_name() fallback also re-fails 3/3 (launch-profile sessions have profile_home None).

adjacent_tests.result: Main: 84 passed, 0 failed. #119346 + fold-ins (fixture correction + regression test): 88 passed, 0 failed (84 + #119346's test + 3 regression cases). Fixture masking: with the six cloud fixtures' 'profile': 'default' key dropped, main fails 3 (test_cloud_gateway_real_action_round_trip_is_bound_to_identity_and_transport, test_cloud_same_identity_reconnect_refreshes_transport_and_completes_pending, test_cloud_explicit_detach_requires_current_authenticated_owner) and #119346 passes 16/16. kvnloo fork #51's 4 repro tests also pass on #119346.

carrier.author: musabatas <musabatas@gmail.com>
carrier.why: The only upstream PR for the defect. It is correct on every launch/request shape probed, uses the canonical helper pair that session rows already use for profile_name (methods_session.py:296, :2241; session_workdir.py:452), is a one-line production change with a round-trip test that fails on main, and merges clean. kvnloo fork #51 is not upstream and is wrong for named-launch gateways and root-homed sessions.

fold_ins.author: kvnloo
fold_ins.hunk_scope: (1) tests/gateway/test_browser_control_cloud.py: drop the line '"profile": "default",' from the six hand-rolled server._sessions fixtures (foldin-fixture-drop-dead-profile-key.diff, -6). Adapted from the fork's fixture migration: the fork replaced the key with a synthetic profile_home '/hermes/profiles/default', but a launch-profile session carries no profile_home, which is the shape kept here. (2) New tests/gateway/test_browser_controller_session_profile.py (3 cases above): adds the named-launch and Hermes-root cases and the fork's artifact-store slot invariant, none of which #119346's own test covers (it pins the launch profile to 'default').
fold_ins.why: With #119346 alone, the six fixtures still pass through a dead 'profile' key that would hide a regression back to session['profile']. #119346's own test cannot distinguish its canonical lookup from a basename shortcut (fork #51's approach passes it).
fold_ins.test: Regression file: FAIL 3/3 on main 298a01c7, PASS 3/3 on main + #119346. Fixture correction: 3 failures on main, 16/16 on main + #119346.
